activation_note: Offline S1 gate, no provider call. Active from E15 (being reworked) onward, or when the writing contract declares dialogue_register_policy=DIALOGUE_REGISTER_V1. Never retroactive for delivered episodes.

rules.DR1: DIALOGUE_SOURCE_VERBATIM: a spoken line shares a run of >= verbatim_min_run characters with the episode's source chapter — the novel's sentence was moved into the script instead of adapted
rules.DR2: DIALOGUE_WRITTEN_REGISTER: a spoken line carries written/classical register markers (为何/之/乃/特制/灵性 …) or narrates a judged comparison about the speaker ('我的力气比他大，速度比他慢') — that is prose or inner monologue, not speech
rules.DR3: DIALOGUE_ONE_VOICE: two speakers with >= 3 lines each have near-identical sentence length (mean gap <= 1.5 chars) and character-bigram vocabulary (Jaccard >= 0.35) — they share one voice
rules.DR4: DIALOGUE_FINGERPRINT_DRIFT: a line breaks the speaker's declared speech_fingerprint (max_chars / banned_words)

fingerprint_fields.where: generation contract (or LINE child entity blocks): speech_fingerprints.<speaker>.{max_chars, banned_words, note}
fingerprint_fields.note: the note is for the writer and the reviewer; only max_chars and banned_words are enforced
